top_stories.title: Hugging Face Releases Carbon-X, a 14B Open DNA Language Model that Brings DNA and Natural Language Together for the First Time
top_stories.description: Hugging Face released Carbon-X, an open 14.8B DNA language model built on Qwen3-14B. It reads raw DNA in chat, answers in English, and averages 66.7% across 5 DNA benchmarks under Apache 2.0. The post Hugging Face Releases Carbon-X, a 14B Open DNA Language Model that Brings DNA and Natural Language Together for the First Time appeared first on MarkTechPost.

top_stories.title: How Bayer Crop Science built an agentic decision engine on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore with AWS Unified Operations
top_stories.description: Bayer Crop Science built the Agentic Decision Engine (ADE), a multi-agent platform on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore that lets breeders, analysts, and researchers ask natural language questions about their analytics platform. This post covers the ADE architecture, five design decisions, and how the team prepared it for production with AWS Unified Operations.

top_stories.title: AI makes junior patent attorneys instantly better but may quietly stunt their professional growth
top_stories.description: A three-month field experiment with 133 patent attorneys shows that AI boosts immediate performance, with junior lawyers gaining the most. But when the AI is taken away, only senior attorneys retain the benefits, suggesting that baseline expertise is a prerequisite for turning AI-assisted practice into lasting skill. The article AI makes junior patent attorneys instantly better but may quietly stunt their professional growth appeared first on The Decoder.
